description: Example gripper on an x/z Cartesian carriage picks a box from the floor and holds it lifted.
gripper: example.json (jaws, travel, drive and friction assumptions reused)

object_x_measured.model: true object x plus Gaussian noise, captured and released at each control step

failure_rules.slip: object was gripped (pad normal force above gripped_force_N) and lost: back within 0.003 m of the floor after lifting at least 0.01 m, or jaws fully closed after contact
failure_rules.miss: jaws closed to within 0.002 m of full travel without ever gripping the object
failure_rules.timeout: none of the above by episode end

splits.leakage_group: object family: width bin x mass bin (3 x 3)

assumption_scope: All carriage masses, drives, ranges, randomization bounds, sensor noise and outcome thresholds are demonstration choices, not measured hardware.
